reports.name: AAFC Outlook for Principal Field Crops (Canada)

outlook: Grains finished lower on Friday. Wheat led the decline, with Chicago December down about 10 cents to near $6.60, a fresh low below its 200-day average, and Minneapolis December spring wheat down about 9 cents to roughly $6.77, as a larger Australian crop weighed on world prices. December corn fell almost 4 cents to about $4.74 and November soybeans slipped under 2 cents to about $12.61, as fast harvest progress and expectations for big U.S. crops outweighed steady Chinese soybean buying, including a 558,000-tonne flash sale. ICE November canola eased C$3.90 to about C$798 per tonne.
